newsitem.title: USA: Culligan to buy Ametek unit.
newsitem.headline: Culligan to buy Ametek unit.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said it entered into an agreement to acquire the water filtration business of Ametek Inc for a total purchase price of $155 million including assumed debt.
The purchase price less debt assumed, which is subject to closing adjustments, is payable in Culligan common stock, valued at a fixed price of $37.50 per share, it said.
Ametek will merge with a unit of Culligan following Ametek's spin-off of its non-water filtration operations, Culligan said.
Under the merger, Ametek stockholders will receive shares of Culligan common stock in exchange for their Ametek stock, and Culligan will own Ametek's water filtration business.
Culligan said it expects it will take four to six months to obtain all of the necessary approvals for the deal.

Ametek's water filtration business makes water filtration and treatment products under the Ametek, Plymouth, American Plumber and other brand names. They are sold in the do-it-yourself, plumbing wholesale, commercial/industrial and water treatment markets.
The 1996 unaudited revenues of the business were about $68 million, a 22 percent increase over 1995.
The acquired assets will include Ametek's 240,000 square foot manufacturing and office facility in Sheboygan, Wis., as well as operations in France and the United Kingdom, it said.

"As a result of this transaction, which we expect to be accretive to earnings, Culligan will have expanded market reach, industry leading products and increased growth potential utilizing two well known brand names," said Culligan chief executive Douglas Pertz.
Culligan makes and distributes water purification and treatment products for retail, household, bottled water, commercial and industrial applications.
